visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A drone with flashing orange lights flies over a gray urban landscape during the day. White wireless earbuds fall into a toilet bowl filled with clear water, creating ripples. A person's hand reaches into the water to grab them. (2) A male presenter with glasses and a black shirt stands in a studio with the Taipei 101 skyline at night behind him. He holds a pen and gestures frequently. A brief animation of the character Moana pointing at the sky is shown, followed by a 2D diagram of a globe with intersecting geometric circles. (3) A large, white, metal box identified as a professional celestial navigation system is shown. This transitions to a digital screen capture of a scientific research paper title. A cockpit instrument panel with a digital flight display is seen, followed by a fighter jet flying in a cloudy sky. (4) Multiple technical diagrams appear showing iterative positioning data points as white clusters with a central red target. A black drone maneuvers against a clear blue sky. A person in a red shirt is seen from behind praying with incense in a temple. (5) An exhibition hall is shown crowded with people looking at various displays. Large drones, some with 'shark teeth' graphics, and missiles are on display. A satellite dish and 'TASA' banners are visible. The presenter returns to conclude the talk against the city backdrop.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 要是你空拍機飛到一半 GPS突然斷線 這瞬間真是比 無線耳機掉進馬桶 還阿雜 不過我雖然這麼說 我還是會直接 手伸手進去拿啦. [Logo]: 泛科學 NEWS. [Slogan]: 沒有GPS，無人機怎麼辦?. [Logo]: 廣告. (2) [Subtitle]: 但這時候 澳洲的科學家們說 怕啥 學學海洋奇緣的莫娜 抬頭看星星啊. (3) [Subtitle]: 問題是以前飛機用的 專業觀星儀 又大又重又貴 不符現代無人機對 尺寸重量和功耗的限制 也就是 SWAP-C. (4) [Subtitle]: 南澳大學與 澳洲國防科技組的科學家想到個省錢做法 成果發表在 《Drones》期刊上. (5) [Subtitle]: 定位誤差從 可能的一百多公里 一口氣縮小到 4公里內. (6) [Subtitle]: 代表就算敵軍用 電子戰干擾GPS 我們無人機也能 抬頭看星星. (7) [Subtitle]: 這場在2025年 9月18到20號 在台北南港展覽館 舉辦的盛會 絕對是你一窺 武裝防禦 與科技樣貌的絕佳機會. (8) [Slogan]: 2025 TADTE 台北國際航太暨國防工業展 不只是看展 更是全方位體驗.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks with high energy and clarity in Traditional Chinese. An upbeat electronic BGM track begins. A distinct splash sound effect is heard, coinciding with the earbuds falling. (2) The voice maintains a fast speech rate, delivering technical information. A 'ding' or bright percussive stinger emphasizes a visual diagram. The BGM remains steady with a synth bassline. (3) Narration continues with professional authority. Brief transition whoosh sounds are added between technical slides. The music tempo stays constant at approximately 124 BPM. (4) A 'dang dang' sound effect highlights a successful data iteration. The vocal tone is informative and slightly playful. (5) Crowd murmurs are faintly audible as the scene shifts to the exhibition. The narrator invites viewers to the event. The music and voice overlap continuously until a clean fade-out at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Problem -> Scientific Solution -> Promotion -> Call to Action.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video explains a novel celestial navigation algorithm that allows drones to fly without GPS by 'looking at the stars.' It uses this technical achievement to transition into a promotion for the 2025 Taipei Aerospace & Defense Industry Exhibition (TADTE), encouraging viewers to see more drone technology there.
